name: mio-integration-calibrated-arm-template
notes: The calibrated arm w1_010_shock10_cal_lp with its matched control w1_010_shock10_cal_warm_lp (twin_warm: form identity, control true, the same state, regressors, line, edge_scale and min_warm_weeks, so it sits in cash on exactly the arm's warm-up weeks). The calibrated arm is meaningful ONLY where the pinned walk's read supports it: read 1, read 2 and read 2w must all be PASS in summary.json (UNRESOLVED and FAIL both close the arm, `calibration_unread`); 2019Q4 is the walk's seed and is refused (`calibration_seed_quarter`). Template, not a run config: nothing here is approved to run. RE-ENTRY Do-not list obeyed: development seal 2021-07-01 (no decision, fill, quote, mark or settlement at or past it; 2021Q3 and later never), no 2024+ data, no run log read, agents report counts, hashes and verdict words only. Every arm is a research arm BESIDE the nine locked formulations (A0010) on a NEW method id; the base formulation is w1_010_shock10_lp, its spec copied verbatim; locked_method_ids is the nine of the queue config. Copy this file to a new name, replace every item of `placeholders` and nothing else. PREREQUISITES in order: (1) diagnostics first, no solve: the ADR-0310 Greeks diagnostics on the saved selection-quarter runs, `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <mio-greeks-<quarter>.json> --asof <date>`; (2) the arm is declared in docs/decisioning/attempts.jsonl BEFORE its first solve (family mio_integration); (3) `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline validate <doc>.json`. RUN COMMAND (repository root, one document at a time): `PYTHONPATH=.:children/index_options python -m dskit.pipeline run <doc>.json --asof <quarter end>` (2021-06-30 for 2021Q2, then 2021-03-31 for 2021Q1, then 2020-03-31 for 2020Q1; exit 0 ran, 1 error or a refusal code, 3 halted). EVIDENCE: only the statuses `closed` or `insufficient` exist on the selection quarters (ADR-0313 section E); a quarter counts for a calibrated arm only with at least min_warm_weeks warm decision weeks; nothing here adopts an arm.
